posts.text:
Trump's AI Force draws shrugs from industry and no detail from the White House

A day after the president promised an AI czar and rejected guardrails, Politico says the industry is scratching its head and CNBC names Jensen Huang as his closest ally.

https://theaipost.net/story/ai-force/

Subscribers sue Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and Google over the AI slowdown

The complaint, reported by the AP, says Dario Amodei's 12 September essay amounted to an invitation to collude, and that a coordinated slowdown cuts the value of paid subscriptions.

https://theaipost.net/story/slowdown-lawsuit/

Bessent and He open talks on AI and critical minerals in New York

The treasury secretary and China's vice premier meet on Sunday ahead of Xi Jinping's visit, with AI, trade and critical minerals on the agenda, Reuters reports.

https://theaipost.net/story/bessent-he/

Big Tech keeps $300bn of AI exposure off its balance sheets, FT reports

Guarantees issued in under a year back debt for data centres and chips while recording little of the exposure, and Nvidia's backing of an OpenAI site is the largest cited.

https://theaipost.net/story/ft-guarantees/

Alibaba's Qwen releases a 7B image model with open weights

Qwen-Image-2.1 generates and edits in one model, takes up to ten reference images and outputs transparent layers, and ComfyUI and vLLM supported it within the hour.

https://theaipost.net/story/qwen-image-21/

StepFun launches Step 5 Preview, with open weights due on 15 October

The Chinese lab's flagship is a 600B-parameter mixture of experts activating 27B per token, with a million-token context and pricing of $1 per million input tokens.

https://theaipost.net/story/step5-preview/

Meta's Muse gets its first television ad as reviewers question its data habits

Alexandr Wang says the spot runs nationwide this weekend, while WIRED reports the app opts users into training-data collection and asks for bank and passport details.

https://theaipost.net/story/muse-tv-ad/

Anthropic engineer factors RSA-896 with Claude and 2,048 idle GPUs

Steve Weis says the model ported a decades-old sieve to GPUs and ran it for ten days, with no new mathematics and no threat to keys in use.

https://theaipost.net/story/rsa-896/

Mathematicians doubt report that OpenAI is close to the Hodge conjecture

The Information cited a person with knowledge of the work. Elliot Glazer says progress on a special case is likely, and a full solution this month is not.

https://theaipost.net/story/hodge-doubts/

xAI's Grok Imagine Image 2.0 climbs to fourth on Artificial Analysis

The benchmark group says the model rose from 18th to 4th in text-to-image, the highest outside OpenAI, at $60 per thousand images against $211 for GPT Image 2.5.

https://theaipost.net/story/grok-imagine-2/
